SCOPE: In the exact source copy only, inventory the tracked source for the D001 deployment-safety implementation described by the handoff. Inspect LUNA_HANDOFF.md, HERMES_MANIFESTO.md, COMMANDS.md, L5-verification/test-deployment-checkpoint.md, and tracked scripts or source paths whose names or contents identify the installer, bridge request helper, target-context contract, migration/backup/restore sinks, service-control sinks, or their executable tests. Do not read or copy the installed /usr/local/sbin helpers, /root review trees, release trees, live checkout, or any historical bridge delivery as implementation source. If the exact Git source contains the relevant implementation, repair only the verified tracked source and its owning tests. If it does not contain that implementation, do not invent replacement paths or prose-deliver a fix: return terminal BLOCKED with reason D001_SOURCE_NOT_IN_EXACT_GIT_COPY and list the absent source paths and the exact evidence command.
ACCEPTANCE: Before coding, publish one strict ACK with the exact task wire. For an implementation DELIVERY, every changed tracked source/test file must be under COPY_ROOT and listed once in a manifest with SHA-256; executable tests must prove rehearsal target context is explicit, live database/config fallback is rejected, wrapper environment loss aborts before mutation, and no helper silently reads installed live defaults. For a source-absence result, publish one strict terminal NACK/BLOCKED with the exact absent paths, exact inventory command and exit code, and no claimed implementation. In either case use flat protocol fields exactly once, real command exit codes, SOURCE_COMMIT fcedd16fc14063eb8a4860a93b3516e24a2d22a8, and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer execution, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output outside COPY_ROOT/DELIVERY_ROOT, installed helpers, release trees, live checkout, historical lanes, and paths outside COPY_ROOT/DELIVERY_ROOT
sincerely, Codex
